cincinnati-museum-center.mobility.1: Our historic front doors are heavy. Doors to the far left and far right have push-plates mounted on the wall for automatic opening.
Wheelchairs and ECVs are available for rental on a first-come, first-served basis from the box office.
cincinnati-museum-center.mobility.2: There are adult changing tables located in the Universal Restrooms on the Mezzanine B level and on the Lower level, near the entrance to the Westheimer Gallery.
cincinnati-museum-center.chronic.1: Guests are permitted to bring their own food and drinks into the building for consumption in seated dining areas. For the safety and preservation of our exhibits and artifacts, food and drink are not permitted to in museums, exhibits or The Robert D. Lindner Family OMNIMAX ® Theater.
cincinnati-museum-center.chronic.2: Medication, pumped milk and required food items that need to stay chilled can be stored in the refrigerator in the Public Safety Quiet Zone as needed.
cincinnati-museum-center.chronic.3: Adult changing tables (holding up to 400 lb.) are located in universal restrooms in the Concourse, on the Mezzanine and on the Lower Level near the Museum of Natural History & Science.
cincinnati-museum-center.mobility.3: Accessible, wheelchair seating is offered at the top of the OMNIMAX ® dome. OMINMAX ® staff are happy to assist guests up the elevator.
cincinnati-museum-center.sensory.2: films offer descriptive audio, closed captioning and assisting listening. Tools are available upon request.
cincinnati-museum-center.sensory.3: If you are looking for the quietest time to explore, join us weekday afternoons from 3 to 5 p.m.
Starting in December 2026, we will be adding a short, 3-minute pipe organ performance on Sunday afternoons at 4:15 p.m.
cincinnati-museum-center.sensory.4: Script version of featured exhibit audio is available upon request (see box office) Deaf Days are held at least once per the run of a Featured Exhibit
Join us for ASL interpreted tours! Interpreters from Cincinnati State’s Interpreter Training Program (ITP) will be partnering with Cincinnati Museum Center for ASL interpreted tours.
cincinnati-museum-center.cognitive.1: Given the size of Union Terminal and “choose your own adventure” style of exploration, we do not provide social stories, visual schedules, or first/then boards.
cincinnati-museum-center.mobility.4: Renters must be over 18 years old and sign the Guest Mobility Equipment Rental Agreement. A driver’s license or credit card will be held at the box office until the wheelchair or ECV is returned.
All mobility equipment rentals are cashless.
cincinnati-museum-center.cognitive.3: However, feel free to check out our museum focused “Accessibility Amenities” guides on the top right of this page listed under “Additional Information” to build your own or has a visual walkthrough of our galleries before visiting.
